story.speaker: Hue
story.message: Welcome to my studio! Every great design starts with color.

story.speaker: Hue
story.message: Warm colors like red and orange feel energetic. Cool colors like blue and green feel calm.

story.speaker: Pixel
story.message: Which colors make YOU feel excited?

concept.title: Warm vs. cool colors
concept.explanation: Warm colors (red, orange, yellow) feel energetic and bold. Cool colors (blue, green, purple) feel calm and relaxed.

playground.instructions: Pick colors and sort them into warm or cool groups.

challenge.prompt: Match each color to warm or cool.

story.speaker: Hue
story.message: Shapes carry feeling too. Circles feel friendly, squares feel solid, triangles feel sharp.

story.speaker: Hue
story.message: Designers pick shapes on purpose, not by accident.

story.speaker: Pixel
story.message: Look around — what shapes do you see in app icons?

concept.title: Shape meaning
concept.explanation: Circles feel soft and friendly, squares feel stable and trustworthy, triangles feel dynamic and energetic.
concept.example: Friendly logo -> circles. Bank logo -> squares.

playground.instructions: Drag shapes onto the mood that fits them best.

challenge.prompt: Which shape usually feels the most friendly and approachable?

story.speaker: Hue
story.message: Great layouts guide the eye. We use spacing and alignment so things don't feel messy.

story.speaker: Hue
story.message: Lining up edges and keeping consistent gaps makes a design feel calm and clear.

story.speaker: Pixel
story.message: A tidy layout is like a tidy room — easier to find what you need!

concept.title: Alignment & spacing
concept.explanation: Aligning elements to a shared edge and keeping consistent spacing between them makes a layout feel organized and easy to scan.
concept.example: Align all card titles to the left edge with the same gap above each one.

playground.instructions: Drag the cards so their edges line up neatly in a grid.

challenge.prompt: Fill in the blank: keeping equal gaps between elements is called ___.
